name: 29Metals Ltd
summary: 29Metals Limited is engaged in the exploration, development, and extraction of base and precious metals, with a particular emphasis on copper. The firm actively searches for mineral deposits containing copper, zinc, gold, and silver. Its portfolio of assets includes the Golden Grove property in Western Australia, the Capricorn Copper operation in Queensland, and the Redhill project in southern Chile. Formed in 2021, 29Metals Limited maintains its head office in Melbourne, Australia.
